name: Codex desktop
description: Project-aware New Tab, usage, preferences, and local editor handoff for the selected thread.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list threads by project.
scopes.usage_app:read: Read the rate limits left on your Codex accounts from cmux's Usage app.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its thread.
scopes.workspace:write: Open a launcher tab in that workspace.
scopes.actions:run: Start a Codex chat from the New Tab, or open a thread in a tab.
scopes.chat:read: Find the selected thread’s local checkout and workspace.
scopes.workspace:execute: Launch the selected desktop app with the checkout as one path argument.
